prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Bind actually acquired bytes/typed records to their exact permitted source identity, parent digest and selected scope.
prime_rows.declared_domain: Registered regular workspace files, full immutable Git regular blobs, protected retained envelopes and exact validated model/carrier records; permitted selectors/read scopes only.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: A source/record read returns locator-only, different-parent or different-hash content, follows an escaped/symlink path, or authenticates caller-imported bytes merely because their payload matches.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Select/traverse only declared typed relationships or original carrier content while preserving its source authority and governing closure.
prime_rows.declared_domain: ac_graph.find/inspect/project_many, authored finite relations, exact JSON-pointer/Markdown projections and selected impact/accounting projections.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: A projected selection omits a required governing closure record, promotes an inferred edge to authority, rewrites an original result, or treats absent edges as proof of non-influence.

accepted_loss.existing_projection_or_observation_exclu: Unselected payload is outside the explicit projection; complete governing closure, original grounding and declared population/boundary semantics remain required.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Compute only the exact registered qualified predicate/join and preserve its original domain outcome, basis, failures and both kinds of gap.
prime_rows.declared_domain: The six finite typed JSON predicate primitives and qualified claude-rc9.conjunction/1 under its exact source-bound plan/order/equal-basis rule.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: A stale held result becomes a fresh invalid_basis component, missing coverage becomes satisfied, mandatory order is replaced by universal precedence, or an output-availability result is used as candidate acceptance.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Construct the exact sealed selected actor-context bytes and retain their acquisition/fit scope without silent omission.
prime_rows.declared_domain: The declared packet, complete selected closure/source content and explicit late reads, fixed UTF-8 rendering, and only the selected declared-capacity fit judgment.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: Dispatched bytes differ from retained rendering, material content is trimmed to fit, stdin-only evidence is called whole-host fit, or null capacity is coerced to satisfied fit.

accepted_loss.existing_projection_or_observation_exclu: Unmeasured host context remains explicit unknown; an unselected numeric fit judgment is unperformed. Neither excludes required material context or manufactures fit.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Decide the complete existing-authority Product/contract/grant/role/basis/result-surface relation through its selected mechanism, separately from drafting or upstream outcome authority.
prime_rows.declared_domain: product-policy-preflight/1 on the exact protected owner-configured binding, including fresh material checks, durable receipt and historical state/application separation.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: Caller-minted grants or self-hashed receipts permit execution, a missing durable surface admits, a stale/superseded receipt remains usable without required recheck, or admission renews Product/outcome authority.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Perform one already-admitted registered exact invocation/cancellation through the reserved Attempt and fixed effect boundary.
prime_rows.declared_domain: Fixed executable/argv/settings/dependencies/Context, Grant-selected sink and named result, private supervisor reconstruction and authorized retry/reconciliation under the cooperative local model.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: An unreserved/forged request reaches launch, dependency drift is ignored, a public request injects shell/argv, or uncertain end/response loss silently causes another launch.

accepted_loss.existing_projection_or_observation_exclu: No OS confinement or arbitrary descendant/external-effect guarantee is claimed; unsupported enforcement refuses and actual unobserved effects/end remain unknown.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Retain actually observed subject/process/effect/event/time/resource facts with scope and unknowns, independently of assertions of success.
prime_rows.declared_domain: Declared current file/config scopes, registered process-end/file-postimage observers, actual output/transport/sink delivery, bounded event waits and source-bound resource samples.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: Process exit alone becomes external completion, cancellation becomes rollback, sink publication becomes consumer receipt, missing usage becomes zero, or equal counter values collapse distinct genuine attempts.

accepted_loss.existing_projection_or_observation_exclu: External exposure/mental attention, consumer acquisition and unobserved descendant/effect/usage scope remain explicitly unestablished unless separately observed; no fact is synthesized.

prime_rows.irreducible_relation: Publish the exact authorized record/evidence unit with its preimage, source owner, provenance and actual publication/effect boundary; retain original history.
prime_rows.declared_domain: Complete protected envelopes/markers/events and one granted Worker/Writer target transition under qualified local POSIX same-directory publication and cooperative serialization.
prime_rows.falsification_condition: An Executive/Reviewer mutates the work carrier, an incomplete/ref-patched envelope is durable support, a conflicting target is overwritten, or publication failure invents rollback/completion or erases history.

accepted_loss.existing_projection_or_observation_exclu: No cross-filesystem transaction is claimed; external-effect/evidence-publication gaps and uncertain target/end are retained and reconstructed, not hidden or waived.

whole_family_contraction.basis: Existing HOW lines 2365–2401, including the complete 23-operation-to-atom mapping and carrier/lifecycle/authority matrix; no new atom or projection is proposed.
whole_family_contraction.relation: Read variants parameterize Acquire/Project, checks and joins parameterize Evaluate, one Context rendering owns Render, one Product-bound relation owns Admit, one reserved registered effect owns Invoke, actual facts share Observe, and existing-grant immutable/Writer publication shares Record. Identity, lifecycle, authority, effect and closure distinctions already recorded in the HOW remain explicit within this same family.
whole_family_contraction.total_realisation_mapping: Core owns typed Acquire/Project/Evaluate/Render and pure Admit/Writer preparation; effects owns the declared Admit/Invoke/Observe/Record publication edges; the adapter projects those contracts without an independent semantic center. The existing HOW operation table is the total mapping, not one atom per operation/module/schema.
whole_family_contraction.standing: Candidate rationale for design-authority assessment, not accepted Prime-conformance or proof from source size/type names.
